templates.title: DiscoPanel
templates.name: discopanel
templates.description: DiscoPanel is a game server panel for Minecraft. It provides a clean interface for creating and managing Minecraft servers, installing modpacks, and running each server as its own Docker container. Features include modpack browsing and installation, per-server configuration, backups, and real-time server management.
templates.note: A game server panel for Minecraft

env.name: DISCOPANEL_DATA_DIR
env.label: DISCOPANEL_DATA_DIR
env.description: Path inside the container where DiscoPanel stores its data

env.name: DISCOPANEL_HOST_DATA_PATH
env.label: DISCOPANEL_HOST_DATA_PATH
env.description: Real host path of the data mount. DiscoPanel passes this to the Minecraft containers it spawns so they can bind-mount their worlds. Must match the host source of the /app/data bind mount.
